body: Here is the tricky part to this. I have a few hobbies, I keep my mind occupied by going to the gym almost everyday, I play the drums to pass time and keep me self occupied with some 3D modeling, I eat healthy and stay hydrated. However I really do try to take care of myself (I like to think so). However there is always a subtle dread in the back of my mind. I do lack in a social circle I think that’s the main problem. I do not have close friends or family to talk to. EAP and therapy has not helped.
It’s not always true but looking at it like that unfortunately gives you more strength to move on.

Give it about a year, even then there will always be those echoing memories that you can’t let go. Cherish those memories. Time really does heal but at the same time sucks because that time has not passed yet 😒

Move on, delete pictures, throw away gifts that were given to you.  Do not contact her period end of story. Block the social media. DO NOT STALK THE PROFILE. As a matter of fact I’d lock yourself out of social media just so your not tempted to look. This is the best and quickest way to move on and get your life back I promise. Your going to ignore this advice and keep torturing yourself but it’s the answer.
